coverage.title: What this board covers
coverage.body: {marksName} are not in Wargaming’s public API, so we read them from the game portal one account at a time, which only happens when someone looks a profile up. This board ranks the {measured} accounts whose garage we have read, out of {tracked} that clear the battle floor: a player nobody has searched for is missing from it rather than last on it.
coverage.freshness: The newest observation behind these counts is from {newest}, the oldest from {oldest}.
coverage.profile: Looking a player up reads their marks, so a profile view is what puts them on this board.
